lines.en: label beachvacation12:
scene sunbathing1
: Hello, ladies.
: You sound kinda creepy when ya just walk up to a group of half-naked girls and say “Hey, ladies,” Sensei.
: Not being creepy isn’t really a strong suit of mine.
: Aww, come on. You’re not that bad.
I stumble upon Chika, Tsuneyo, and Miku laying out on a blanket once the afternoon rolls around.
And, in case you were wondering, no. Maya didn’t actually die during the watermelon incident.
Thankfully, Karin was able to hold back and only used a fraction of her true power.
So Maya got off without any internal bleeding whatsoever.
What a joyous occasion.
: You.
: Hi, Tsuneyo.
scene sunbathing2
: Ah-
scene sunbathing1
: Wait, no. Stop that.
: I am mad at you.
: Why? I haven’t even really seen you since yesterday and-
: Oh.
: Yeah, I probably know what this is about.
scene sunbathing3
: Sneaky move havin’ us girls do yer’ dirty work for ya. Karin almost died.
: Is that why she was passed out in her breakfast when I made it to the beach this morning?
: Yup! Ruined a perfectly good dish and Ayane had to go buy her another one.
: Oh. Well then no one lost except for Ayane’s dad. This seems fine to me.
scene sunbathing4
: Wrong. I lost.
: I learned things today that I was not ready to learn.
: To be fair, these are things you probably should have learned about a while ago.
: Fuck you.
: Yeah...Think I’m gonna go out on a limb and side with Tsuneyo here, Sensei.
: It’s probably for the best if you just...don’t talk about masturbation or sex or anything like that with her.
: I don’t think she’s prepared for that kinda stuff yet.
scene sunbathing5
: Yeah. Not everyone here’s as mature as Chika and me, Sensei. Some people just take a little longer to develop. Like noodle-girl!
: Wow, Miku. I had no idea you were ready to talk about stuff like that.
: Whaddya mean? I’m ready to talk about anythin’ ya throw at me. Just name it.
: Any thoughts on reverse cowgirl?
scene sunbathing6
: Sensei! What do you think you’re asking her?!
jump cowboyx
label cowboyx:
: Reverse what? What’s that mean?
: See?! She has no idea!
: What do cowboys have to do with...the M word.
: It’s cowgirls. And they have more to do with the S word than the M word.
scene sunbathing7
: That word is even worse.
: Wait, hold the phone. I still have no idea what’s goin’ on. I’ve never heard of the backwards cowboy either.
: You completely changed the name of the position. Don’t slander reverse cowgirl like that.
: Okay! That’s it! Changing the subject!
: Sensei, how was your night? Did you do anything fun?
scene sunbathing8
: Well, I watched the girls play a weird game with Tsuneyo. And then I hung out with Sana for a bit.
scene sunbathing9
: Oh. I remember that.
: I don’t think I like beer very much.
scene sunbathing10
: You got her drunk?
: She got herself drunk. I just...didn’t stop her.
: You didn’t do anything...weird to her, did you?
: I woke up in the middle of the night and was tucked into a futon.
: This means he must have done something weird to me.
: I might be sheltered, but I’m capable of putting myself to bed, thank you very much.
: That was probably one of the girls. I sort of just pushed you off of me when I left the room last night.
: Oh. That’s okay then.
: But we still need to find out who did weird things to me.
scene sunbathing11
: Oh! That was me.
: You weren’t really sleepin’ in the best spot so I kinda just dragged ya into bed and put the blanket around you.
: Crazy, too. You must have drank a lot ‘cause ya didn’t wake up when I accidentally touched ‘yer boob.
: So you did do weird things to me.
: Mmm...kinda! But it was on accident.
scene sunbathing12
: That’s what they all say...
: So, what’s this about you and Sana?
: I know that Rin and some of the others were going to be playing a game, so I get that part. But wasn’t Sana playing with them?
: When would you two have even met up?
: I think it was around 3 AM.
scene sunbathing13
: Wh-what?! What the hell were you two doing alone that late?
: Holy crap! Were you givin’ Sana that reverse cowboy thing from earlier?! Is that why she’s still passed out after noon?!
: Wait? She’s still asleep?
: Heck yeah and it’s all your fault!
: Fuck you.
: Let me just clear up this misunderstanding now because that’s definitely not what happened.
: I never had plans with Sana. I just woke up in the middle of the night and went for a walk.
: She happened to be sitting on the beach so the two of us just chatted about stuff for a while and then went back.
scene sunbathing14
: So...nothing else happened after that?
: Nothing else happened after that.
: Well then why the heck is she still asleep? Did somebody else give her the cowboy?
: I really hope not. I don’t know how I’d deal with that news.
: Something about your story seems a little fishy...but I won’t push any further.
: Tell that to the guy who cowboyed Sana. He did plenty of pushing from what I gather.
: Okay, Miku, please don't use 'cowboy' as a verb.
scene sunbathing15
: Joke’s on you! I don’t even remember what a verb is!
: Well, at the very least, don’t go around spreading rumors about Sana and me.
: Awfully suspicious thing for ya to say when ‘yer out there givin’ the quietest girl in class the-
scene sunbathing16
: Say “cowboy” one more time and I’m cutting the straps off of your swimsuit!
scene sunbathing17
: Ah! No! I’m flat as a board! It’ll fall right off!
: I don’t think this is one of those kind of beaches either!
: And if it is, all of us have been treatin’ this whole weekend very differently than we’re supposed to!
: Is talking with other girls normally this confusing?
: Talking with you is actually more confusing.
: How? I only talk about noodles.
: Well...true. At least your conversations are easy to follow.
: But that doesn’t make them any less confusing thematically.
scene sunbathing18
: I just want to be a normal girl enjoying her youth.
: But I’m afraid that ship has sailed now that I have learned the proper way to explore my body.
: I know you didn’t mean anything by that, but it sounded very seductive.
: I’m scared. What if I don’t like how it feels?
scene sunbathing19
: What the Hell are you making her talk about?!
: Okay, this time I really didn’t do anything. She just started saying all that by herself.
: Likely story! You’re grounded!
: You can’t ground me...I’m over twice your age.
I think.
: Doesn’t matter.
: Tsuneyo is pure and oblivious and it’s super cute and if you even think of corrupting her I swear on my love for idols that I will end you.
scene sunbathing20
: I’m afraid that I was already corrupted by Miku last night.
: It’s true. Got a pretty good feel, too. Nice and firm. Totally not jealous.
scene sunbathing21
: Thank you.
: I think you have very nice legs.
: Thanks! I run a lot so they’re pretty muscley, but I think they’re nice too.
What is it with Tsuneyo and legs? She said the same thing about Ami.
: Do you think I could touch them?
scene sunbathing22
: What, you mean like, as revenge for me accidentally copping a feel last night?
: No. I just want to touch them.
scene sunbathing23
: Umm...it’s...kinda embarrassing when you put it that way. But I guess it’s fine.
: Thank you.
: Please do not touch my boob again, though.
: That area is reserved for the man I fall in love with.
: You are very pretty, but I fear that we will never fall in love.
scene sunbathing24
: I can’t tell if this is helpin’ my self-esteem or ruining it.
: I’ve heard that it’s hard figuring out what I mean at times, so I understand.
scene sunbathing25
: I’m guessing this isn’t really how you imagined your morning going, is it?
: No, I’ve come to basically expect things like this every day. This is my life now.
: You doing anything afterward?
: After this? Not anything I can think of. How about you?
scene sunbathing26
: Rin and I were gonna hang out later. Think there was something she wanted to talk about.
: We had a little bit of a heart-to-heart last night. A lot different from how we were that one time at the cafe.
: I’m glad she’s been in a better mood lately. Seeing her get all weird was a hardcore bummer when I know how bright and cheerful she can be.
Huh...interesting.
If there’s something Rin wanted to talk to Chika about...she couldn’t be thinking of confessing, could she?
I feel like that’s something I would have known about beforehand.
I’ll have to talk to her sometime before the two of them meet up and see what’s going on.
: Well, that’s good. I’m glad you two are getting along well. You have weirdly good chemistry.
scene sunbathing27
: I know, right?! Like, I’ve got plenty of friends, don’t get me wrong, but no one that’s like her.
: Everybody I hang out with is more into like, fashion and stuff like that. But Rin is super creative and I totally respect that kind of person.
: Did you know she plays guitar?
: I did.
scene sunbathing28
: So cool, right?!
: Do you think she’d teach me?
: That’s...something you’d have to ask her about.
: Yeah, I figured. I know you two are close, so I just wasn’t sure if you’d know the answer off the top of your head or not.
scene sunbathing29
: Also, between you and me...I think she might have a crush on you.
That’s not good.
I’m not sure what Chika and Rin talked about last night, but I’m pretty sure that Rin’s true feelings didn’t come across if this is the impression Chika was left with.
if chikadorm20 == True:
: What are you gonna say to her if that’s true?
: Like...you and me are already a thing.
: And I love the girl but...I don’t really want to share you. And she doesn’t know about us either.
: You know...maybe it’s best if we talk about this when there aren’t two other girls sitting right next to you.
: But I’m a really good whisperer. See? They haven’t even noticed.
: I see that. But I’m a very bad whisperer and they would definitely notice if I tried saying something.
: Okay. We can talk later then.
: Works for me...
else:
: What are you going to do if that’s true?
: I haven’t really thought about it, to be honest...
Well, correction- I have thought about it.
But Rin’s made it overwhelmingly apparent how interested in Chika she is.
I mean, the girl is basically obsessed.
So what I’m more concerned about than anything is how Chika will react if she finds out it’s her that Rin is into.
Because right now...it seems like she doesn’t have any idea whatsoever.
And that worries me.
So...maybe there’s a way for me to find out?
: If you were in my shoes, what would you do?
: If I were in your shoes?
scene sunbathing30
: Hmm...
: Well...I obviously can’t get into your head so I don’t know how attracted you are to her...
: But I would consider that there are probably several other girls into you as well...And some might be a little more suited to your tastes or-
scene sunbathing31
: More mature...
scene sunbathing32
: Not to say she’s not or anything! It’s just...you know.
scene sunbathing33
: Hey, what are you guys whisperin’ about over there?
: Huh?! Oh! Uhh...nothing! We were just talking about our plans for tonight and stuff...
: Well then why the heck were you whispering? You guys up to some secret, no-good stuff?
: We’re not up to anything!
: You’re up to something.
: You too, Tsuneyo?!
scene sunbathing34
: Ah-
scene black
The conversation quickly spirals into a series of other spontaneous topics like where we’d want our next vacation to be or what the girls plan on dressing up as for Halloween.
Apparently, Tsuneyo had never heard of Halloween, so we needed to explain that to her...which took around half an hour or so.
Actually, I’m pretty sure it took even longer.
I wound up leaving before the discussion ended and started heading back to the inn to take a break from everything...
